newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 20 bln levs 5-yr T-bonds at par.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 20 bln levs 5-yr T-bonds at par.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry issue of 20 billion levs of five-year, floating interest T-bonds was 100 percent sold at par value at Friday's auction, giving 63.20 percent effective annual yield, central bank figures showed.
The issue was offered with no minimum acceptable price set in advance.
Interest on the paper was set at four percentage points over the central bank annual main interest rate and would be adjusted each time the main rate changes during the period to maturity.
The central bank on Thursday said it will cut its main rate to 51.48 percent annually from 62.4 percent, to go in force from Monday, May 19.
The effective annual yield on the issue was calculated under the new, lower main interest rate of 51.48 percent, a central bank official told Reuters.
Coupon payments are due semi-annually until maturity. Principal is due at maturity together with the last coupon payment.
